name: zmodel_fog_set_color_rgb01
description: zModel fog color setter copies the RGB float triplet and forwards it to zVideo when a hardware renderer path is active.
known_limits: Tier C only; no reviewed VC COFF byte comparison has been accepted, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4762c0 validates copying rgb01[0..2] into gModel_FogColorRgb01, testing g_zVideo_ActiveRendererPath, returning immediately when it is zero, and tail-jumping to zVideo::SetFogColorFromRgb01 when it is nonzero.
Binary Ninja assembly for dependency 0x4a7220 validates zVideo::SetFogColorFromRgb01 multiplying each RGB float by 255.0f and storing g_zVideo_FogColorPendingR255/G255/B255.

Native smoke zmodel_fog_set_color_rgb01_smoke verifies the software path copies model fog color without touching pending renderer fog color and the active renderer path also updates the zVideo pending 255-scale globals.
